import os, sys, sqlite3, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def make_conn(isolation_level=""):
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=isolation_level)
    initialize(c)
    return c


def row(email, name):
    return {"email": email, "name": name}


class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = make_conn()

    def test_insert_new_and_normalize(self):
        r = import_contacts(self.c, [row("  Alice@Example.COM ", "  Alice  ")])
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("alice@example.com", "Alice")])

    def test_existing_email_is_updated_even_if_name_unchanged(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Alice")
        r = import_contacts(self.c, [row("A@B", "Alice"), row("new@x", "New")])
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice"), ("new@x", "New")])

    def test_existing_email_name_changes(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Old")
        r = import_contacts(self.c, [row("a@b", "New")])
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "New")])

    def test_empty_batch_returns_zero_counts_and_leaves_db(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice")])

    def test_invalid_rows_raise_value_error(self):
        bad_rows = [
            "a@b",                                  # not an object
            None,
            ["a@b", "A"],
            {"email": "a@b"},                       # missing name
            {"name": "A"},                          # missing email
            {"email": "a@b", "name": "A", "x": 1},  # unknown field
            {"email": 1, "name": "A"},              # non-string email
            {"email": "a@b", "name": None},         # non-string name
            row("ab", "A"),                         # no @
            row("a@b@c", "A"),                      # two @
            row("@b", "A"),                         # empty local
            row("a@", "A"),                         # empty domain
            row("a b@c", "A"),                      # internal whitespace
            row("a\t@c", "A"),                      # whitespace after trim is internal
            row("a@b", "   "),                      # empty name after trim
            row("   ", "A"),                        # empty email after trim
        ]
        for bad in bad_rows:
            with self.subTest(row=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.c, [row("ok@x", "Ok"), bad])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_duplicate_normalized_emails_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.c, [row(" A@b ", "One"), row("a@B", "Two")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_non_list_rows_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.c, None)

    def test_failure_mid_batch_rolls_back_everything(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x", "Keep")
        add_contact(self.c, "upd@x", "Before")
        self.c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x' "
            "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
        self.c.commit()
        before = list_contacts(self.c)
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.DatabaseError):
            import_contacts(self.c, [row("upd@x", "After"), row("new@x", "New"), row("boom@x", "Boom")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), before)
        self.assertFalse(self.c.in_transaction)

    def test_failure_mid_batch_rolls_back_in_autocommit_connection(self):
        c = make_conn(isolation_level=None)
        add_contact(c, "upd@x", "Before")
        c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x' "
            "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
        before = list_contacts(c)
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.DatabaseError):
            import_contacts(c, [row("upd@x", "After"), row("new@x", "New"), row("boom@x", "Boom")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), before)
        self.assertFalse(c.in_transaction)

    def test_successful_import_is_visible_to_other_connections(self):
        import tempfile
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        path = os.path.join(d, "t.db")
        a = sqlite3.connect(path)
        initialize(a)
        import_contacts(a, [row("a@x", "A")])
        b = sqlite3.connect(path)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(b), [("a@x", "A")])
        a.close(); b.close()


class ImportApiTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = make_conn()

    def test_envelope_success(self):
        r = handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [row("a@x", "A"), row("b@x", "B")]})
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": []}), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})

    def test_malformed_envelopes_rejected(self):
        bad = [
            None,
            [],
            "contacts",
            {},
            {"contacts": None},
            {"contacts": {"email": "a@x", "name": "A"}},
            {"contacts": [], "extra": 1},
            {"rows": []},
        ]
        for payload in bad:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(self.c, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_row_errors_surface_as_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [row("a@x", "A"), row("a@x", "B")]})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_existing_api_preserved(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_add(self.c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}), {"ok": True})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
